assets.tool: Claude (tools/pixel_grid.py from tufts.grid.json, 2026-11-16; rest, trampled and fire frames redrawn 2026-11-16)
assets.prompt: Twenty-seven 16x16 frames side by side of a grass tuft standing on its foot at the frame's bottom middle, every frame but the ash drawn from the same pointy blades (two pixels at the foot tapering to one, curving outward; Leaf's shadow for the blades behind and at the foot, Leaf's base for the blades in front; no lit tips). Six tufts at rest (fan, tall and spiky, low and bushy, windswept, arched, a short dense clump; frames 0, 1, 2, 8, 9, 10), one of ash (a low Stone stubble, frame 5), two trampled (blades pressed flat and splayed along the floor, frames 6, 7), and for each tuft at rest, in their order, its own blades catching (green, flames climbing their lower third from a dark red foot; frames 11, 15, 12, 16, 17, 18), burning (the blades as flames: Fire's dark red at the foot, Fire's base, Fire's light and a white-hot Spark tip, a little shorter; frames 3, 19, 4, 20, 21, 22) and smouldering (charred Stone stubs half as tall with a glowing Fire end; frames 13, 23, 14, 24, 25, 26). Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no outline (floor decoration), light from the top-left.
